name: @shres-code/shres-code-desktop
description: Electron desktop shell for a bundled shres runtime and external plugins

scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:runtime-tree && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs && pnpm run finalize-package
scripts.package:dir: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:runtime-tree && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.config.mjs && pnpm run finalize-package
